category_fit.consequence: No NoLACE reference can be built without the exact Opus 1.5 decoder and its postfilter configuration surface; this package is a blocker record, not a codec or postfilter implementation.
category_fit.source_statement: For Opus, evaluate the codec-integrated LACE/NoLACE neural postfilters; their decoder has access to codec-specific information. They are part of Opus 1.5 and are not enabled by default.

release_gates.requirement: Pinned, hash-verified Opus 1.5 source revision or official build with LICENSE/NOTICE reviewed for that exact revision and explicit approval to execute the native decoder.
A documented and tested Opus 1.5 decoder API/configuration that selects NoLACE (LACE disabled) and the contrast LACE condition at the intended packet geometry.
Rights-cleared low-bitrate Opus packets plus matching encoder revision, bitrate, frame duration, bandwidth and loss/erasure metadata trace for evaluation and derived outputs.
A paired LACE versus NoLACE isolation run on the same packets and decoder revision, with the postfilter toggle as the only changed variable and a decoder-specific control.
Exact decoded source/output intervals, discrete concealment and validity accounting, and rejected/invalid packet outcomes for the restoration profile.
Task-specific quality on genuine low-bitrate traffic with output peak bounds, clean-reference comparison and an established task-matched control.
Target-device content and availability timing, memory and callback/deadline budget for the exact decoder workload.
Provider/catalog/license intake, descriptor and public-surface review, plus explicit release approval before any exposure.
